space.name: Dock Loading Domain Layout 05 (T-K part 1, step 6)
space.notes: env_layout_03 with coffee_machine_0 moved to (-90, 250), in the hall beside the office door (T-K part 1, step 6; design_records.md, "T-K", STEP 6, its addition). Why: from either bay and from the standby place the walk to the coffee break and the walk to the office break begin in nearly the same direction, so break_time is the one thing that can tell the two foreseeable tasks apart early; testable: the raised coffee break against the office break on one shared walk. Everything else is env_layout_03's. origin (0,0) at the centre of the hall, y up. T-G stage 1 room (design_decisions.md, "T-G: the second domain's rulings", B14). The space is centred on the origin, x [-600, 600], y [-740, 740]: it holds every fixed object, the truck included (y from -740 to -440) and the office (y up to 415).

areas.label: truck_side: the dock platform (y -440 to -300) and the truck (x -125 to 125, y -740 to -440), outside the gate; written as one rectangle, the form holds one rectangle per area
